records.name: Spur gear pair
records.problem_solved: Reduce speed and increase output torque
records.physics_representation: Two revolute joints; q_out=-(20/60)q_in; inertias plus gear coupling
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Backlash, tooth strength, efficiency, bearing layout
records.fabrication_route: Print test gears; purchase bearings and shafts
records.notes: Proposed pitch diameters 20/60 mm; center distance 40 mm. No rated torque assigned.

records.name: Planetary reducer
records.physics_representation: Fixed ring; carrier output; ratio 1+54/18=4; equivalent reducer or explicit gears
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Carrier strength, planet phasing, backlash, losses
records.notes: Ring pitch diameter 54 mm; equally spaced planets satisfy (54+18)/3=24.

records.name: Bevel gear pair
records.physics_representation: Two intersecting revolute axes plus 1:1 coupling
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Pitch cone, thrust bearings, tolerances, efficiency
records.fabrication_route: Printed prototype or purchased bevel pair

records.name: Worm reducer
records.physics_representation: Coupled revolute axes; 30:1 ratio; include direction-dependent losses
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Lead angle, friction, thermal limits, backlash
records.fabrication_route: Print demonstrator or use metal worm set
records.notes: Self-locking must be evaluated; it is not guaranteed by the mechanism name.

records.name: Rack and pinion
records.physics_representation: Revolute plus prismatic; x=0.010 theta in SI
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Backlash, guide friction, mesh preload, tooth loads
records.fabrication_route: Print rack prototype; purchase linear guide

records.name: Cycloidal reducer
records.problem_solved: Compact high ratio with distributed pin contacts
records.physics_representation: Equivalent geared joint initially; explicit eccentric/pin contacts for detailed study
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Exact lobe/pin geometry, eccentricity, output pin clearances, efficiency
records.fabrication_route: CAD extraction then printed disk and metal pins
records.notes: 80×25 mm is a proposed envelope; not an extracted dimension of the cited design.

records.name: Timing-belt rotary reduction
records.problem_solved: Move motor away from joint; lower transmission mass
records.physics_representation: Coupled revolute joints; optional elastic torsion and belt slip
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Exact tooth profile, belt length, tension, shaft loads
records.notes: Proposed pitch diameters 12.732/38.197 mm. Exact belt length must be selected, then centers adjusted.

records.name: Belt-driven linear axis
records.physics_representation: Prismatic output x=(0.040/(2*pi))theta; reflected inertia
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Belt stretch, carriage mass, guide loads, motor torque-speed curve

records.name: Trapezoidal lead-screw axis
records.physics_representation: Prismatic output x=(0.002/(2*pi))theta; Coulomb friction and backlash
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Nut geometry, efficiency, critical speed, buckling, support bearings
records.notes: Proposed Tr8×2-like single-start configuration. Lead=pitch×starts; never infer lead from diameter alone.

records.name: CoreXY stage
records.physics_representation: Two prismatic coordinates; belt displacements u=x+y, v=x-y for chosen routing
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Routing signs, belt compliance, pulley alignment, moving mass
records.fabrication_route: Open printer CAD/BOM plus custom carriage
records.notes: Axes/sign convention must be checked against the actual routing.

records.name: Four-bar parallelogram
records.physics_representation: Four revolute joints with loop closure; select assembly branch
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Joint clearances, collision, singular poses, link mass
records.license_scope: SALAR software MIT; proposed geometry authored here

records.name: Slider-crank
records.physics_representation: Revolute crank and rod plus prismatic slider; closure constraint
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Guide friction, pin play, side load, speed-dependent forces
records.notes: In-line stroke is 2r; use analytical or native transmission before tooth/contact detail.

records.name: Parallel two-jaw gripper
records.physics_representation: Two opposite-axis prismatic joints; equal displacement coupling; pad contact
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Jaw force, pads, friction, actuator, link mass
records.notes: Worked example uses this proposed mechanism; no payload claimed.

training_profile.first_task: grasp, slip and release primitives before manipulation

records.name: Tendon underactuated finger
records.problem_solved: Conform to irregular objects with fewer motors
records.physics_representation: Rigid segments with hinge springs; routed tendon and unilateral tension
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Tendon routing, friction, preloads, flexure stiffness, pad material
records.license_scope: CC-BY-NC-3.0 hardware repository; noncommercial restriction; not unrestricted OSS
records.notes: Proposed 90 mm finger is not a Yale model dimension.

training_profile.first_task: grasp, slip and release primitives before manipulation

records.name: Pulley-tree differential
records.problem_solved: Share actuator travel among fingers after contact
records.physics_representation: Spatial/fixed tendons with differential length constraints
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Slack, pretension, pulley friction, mechanical travel stops

records.name: Flexure hinge
records.physics_representation: Small-deflection spring hinge; FEM for large strain/fatigue
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Material E, damping, print anisotropy, strain limits
records.fabrication_route: Print beam coupon or mold elastomer
records.notes: Proposed beam. Approximate end-moment rotation stiffness E*b*t^3/(12*L); boundary conditions matter.

records.name: PneuNet bending actuator
records.problem_solved: Gentle compliant grasp or distributed bending
records.physics_representation: Hyperelastic FEM with pressure loading; fitted rigid segment surrogate for control
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Material law, chamber geometry, pressure limits, leakage
records.fabrication_route: Print molds; cast elastomer; pneumatic supply
records.notes: Proposed envelope; toolkit provides modeling files, not validation for these dimensions.

records.name: Granular/passive jamming grip
records.physics_representation: Calibrated stiffness/contact surrogate; DEM/FEM for granular detail
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Jamming method, particle packing, pressure or deformation curve
records.notes: Passive jamming and vacuum jamming are distinct activation methods.

training_profile.first_task: grasp, slip and release primitives before manipulation

records.name: Vacuum suction end effector
records.physics_representation: Seal-dependent attachment force; release on seal loss
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Effective area, surface leakage, peel load, vacuum flow
records.fabrication_route: Buy cup and vacuum hardware; print mount
records.notes: Ideal full-area force at proposed 40 kPa is 12.57 N; not a rated holding force.

training_profile.first_task: grasp, slip and release primitives before manipulation

records.name: Differential-drive base
records.physics_representation: Wheel revolute joints; v=r(wR+wL)/2, yaw=r(wR-wL)/track; contact
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: COM, tire friction, caster drag, encoder and drive parameters

records.name: Mecanum base
records.problem_solved: Strafe and turn in confined flat-floor spaces
records.physics_representation: Explicit roller contacts or calibrated anisotropic friction approximation
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Roller geometry, friction direction, slip, wheel order
records.notes: Plain cylindrical wheels with isotropic friction do not reproduce mecanum behavior.

records.name: OpenMANIPULATOR-X
records.physics_representation: Import revision-specific links/joints/inertias; current limits and gripper contacts
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: CAD revision, measured friction, payload pose and duty cycle
records.license_scope: Open hardware/software advertised; individual asset license not audited

records.name: SO-101 / SO-ARM100 repository
records.physics_representation: Use selected Simulation asset; match follower motors, axes and calibration
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Exact variant, link lengths/masses, servo model, gripper contact
records.license_scope: Apache-2.0 repository; per-file scope still check

records.name: BCN3D Moveo
records.physics_representation: Reconstruct tree from CAD; geared stepper drives
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: CAD extraction, ratios, masses, torque-speed curves, print stiffness
records.fabrication_route: Printed bodies and purchased motion hardware
records.license_scope: Open-source claim; exact asset license not audited

records.name: Annin AR4
records.physics_representation: Six revolute links with geared drives; choose manual/model revision first
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Conflicting reach/repeatability, exact revision, asset licenses, inertia
records.fabrication_route: Machined aluminum plus purchased transmission components
records.license_scope: Build resources available; hardware redistribution rights not established
records.notes: FAQ says 26 inches (67 cm); conversion is rounded/inconsistent. Neither figure is accepted as canonical here.

records.name: Yale OpenHand Model T
records.physics_representation: Underactuated tendon, pulley differential, compliant joints
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: CAD dimension extraction, stiffness, damping, pretension
records.license_scope: CC-BY-NC-3.0 hardware repository; noncommercial restriction; not unrestricted OSS

records.name: Yale OpenHand T42
records.physics_representation: Independent finger tendons and compliant joints
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Selected pivot/flexure variant, material and cord properties
records.license_scope: CC-BY-NC-3.0 hardware repository; noncommercial restriction; not unrestricted OSS

records.name: ODRI actuator / Solo family
records.physics_representation: Actuator rotor/transmission inertia; articulated legs and foot contacts
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Choose module/Solo revision, ratios, motor parameters, contacts

records.name: Open-Source Leg
records.physics_representation: Articulated joints with actuator dynamics and load interaction
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Hardware generation, geometry/masses, actuator limits, compliant interface
records.fabrication_route: Machined parts and purchased actuator hardware
records.notes: Research reference; this catalog does not establish suitability for human use.

records.name: Linorobot2
records.problem_solved: Configurable mobile base with ROS2 simulation path
records.physics_representation: Dimensioned xacro; wheel drive and sensors; Gazebo integration
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Selected base geometry, motor SKU, friction, calibration

records.name: OpenCat firmware paradigm
records.physics_representation: Position-controlled leg chain plus servo lag and ground contact
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Chassis CAD openness, servo dynamics, generation-specific geometry
records.fabrication_route: Use verified open chassis or independently authored geometry
records.license_scope: MIT firmware; chassis hardware rights not established

records.name: Stanford Pupper reference
records.physics_representation: Leg kinematics, servo drive model, ground contact
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Generation, hardware geometry, torque limits, mass/inertia
records.license_scope: Software/hardware asset license scopes not audited

records.name: SKF 608-2Z bearing
records.physics_representation: Usually represented by revolute joint plus friction; shell merged to link
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Fits, suffix-specific loads, friction, mass
records.fabrication_route: Buy steel bearing; recreate envelope and mounting pockets
records.license_scope: Commercial part; published dimensions are interface references

records.name: 17HS19-2004S1 stepper
records.problem_solved: Drive small axes and reduction mechanisms
records.physics_representation: Torque-speed/current model with rotor inertia; step-loss behavior if needed
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Shaft/mount drawing, inertia, driver supply, thermal limits
records.notes: Holding torque is not moving or continuous torque; 24 V curve conditions are specific.

records.name: DYNAMIXEL XM430-W350
records.physics_representation: Torque-limited servo with gearing, lag, friction, temperature state
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Continuous torque, horn/shaft interfaces, thermal derating, inertia
records.fabrication_route: Buy servo; import drawing/CAD for mounts
records.license_scope: Commercial servo; software availability does not make motor hardware OSS

records.name: Pololu 37D gearmotor family
records.physics_representation: DC motor plus chosen gearbox; encoder on motor shaft
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Exact SKU, length, torque-speed/current curves, shaft drawing
records.notes: Output counts depend on exact gear ratio and decode convention; CPR must not be blindly multiplied by four.

records.name: 2 mm pitch synchronous belt interface
records.physics_representation: Constraint or elastic transmission; belt visual mesh separate
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Exact profile, material, width, load rating and length
records.notes: GT2 family naming alone is insufficient for tooth-profile matching.

records.name: MGN12 miniature rail family
records.physics_representation: Prismatic joint; block/rail usually rigid or fixed components
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: C versus H variant; full hole pattern, preload, load moments, friction
records.notes: Do not use family name as a complete carriage envelope.

records.name: 20×20 extrusion family
records.physics_representation: Fixed rigid members initially; beam elements for deflection
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Exact slot series, cross-section inertia, mass per metre, joint stiffness
records.fabrication_route: Buy and cut extrusion; print compatible brackets
records.notes: 2020 describes envelope, not universal T-nut compatibility.

records.name: ISO4762 socket cap screw family
records.physics_representation: Fixed constraints or bolt preload/contact model when needed
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Pitch, grade, head dimensions, torque, thread engagement
records.fabrication_route: Buy screws; model clearance and head pockets
records.notes: M3×12 is a proposed selection; extract full manufacturer drawing before manufacturing pockets.

records.name: AS5048A magnetic angle sensor
records.physics_representation: Angle observation with noise, quantization, bias and delay
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Magnet dimensions/gap, PCB envelope, absolute accuracy, calibration
records.fabrication_route: Buy IC/module; author mount and magnet holder
records.notes: Quantization step 360/16384=0.02197 degrees; not angular accuracy.

records.name: BMI088 IMU
records.problem_solved: Estimate motion and attitude in dynamic robots
records.physics_representation: Accelerometer specific force and gyro angular rate; noise/bias/latency
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Board footprint, selected ranges, noise spectra, orientation calibration

records.name: moteus brushless controller
records.physics_representation: Actuator/current loop and communications delay; controller is not a motor
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Board revision, motor constants, encoder, electrical/thermal limits
records.fabrication_route: Buy board or fabricate licensed design

records.name: BOSL2 parametric geometry
records.problem_solved: Generate gears and interface geometry from parameters
records.physics_representation: Geometry generator only; attach independent physics metadata
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Pin commit; define units and manufacturing tolerances

records.name: NopSCADlib component library
records.problem_solved: Reuse purchased-part models and BOM structure
records.physics_representation: Geometry/BOM only; derive dynamics from real components
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Pin commit; verify exact SKU and source license scope

records.name: URDF / xacro
records.problem_solved: Describe rigid robot geometry and kinematic tree
records.physics_representation: Links, tree joints, collision, inertial tensors; engine control extensions
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Closed-loop and transmission support varies by importer
records.license_scope: Format reference; software package licenses separate

records.name: MuJoCo MJCF
records.physics_representation: Bodies, joints, actuators, tendons and equality constraints
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Engine version, contact calibration, timestep and convergence

records.name: SCARA serial arm
records.problem_solved: Planar pick-and-place with separate vertical motion
records.physics_representation: Two parallel-axis revolute joints plus prismatic Z; optional wrist rotation
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Joint limits, motor/gear selection, stiffness, tool load
records.fabrication_route: Printed/machined links with bearings and linear Z
records.notes: Proposed planar reach 300 mm, excluding tool offset; folded singularity needs joint limits.

records.name: Delta parallel manipulator
records.problem_solved: Low moving mass for rapid translational positioning
records.physics_representation: Three driven arms and parallel forearm constraints; native loop closure
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Full anchor frames, workspace, collisions, link mass, actuator limits
records.notes: Proposed geometry only; no working envelope or cycle rate claimed.

records.name: Stewart parallel platform
records.problem_solved: Six-axis orientation and positioning of a platform
records.physics_representation: Six struts with ball/universal joints and loop constraints; IK from attachment coordinates
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Six paired attachment frames, actuator lengths, singularities, mass and stiffness
records.notes: Radii and height are insufficient to compile; anchor angles must be supplied.

records.name: Quasi-direct-drive joint
records.problem_solved: Backdrivable torque control with modest reduction
records.physics_representation: Low-ratio drive with reflected rotor inertia, torque/current control and saturation
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Motor Kt/Kv, winding resistance, rotor inertia, gearing and thermal limits
records.fabrication_route: BLDC motor, low ratio reducer, encoder and controller
records.notes: Proposed 6:1 and 80 mm are independent choices, not source specifications.

records.name: Series-elastic actuator
records.problem_solved: Measure force from spring deflection and absorb shock
records.physics_representation: Separate motor/output coordinates; spring torque k*(theta_motor/N-theta_out) plus damping
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Spring calibration, fatigue, sensors, preload, controller bandwidth
records.fabrication_route: Motor/reducer plus designed spring and dual sensing
records.notes: Proposed spring torque at 10 degrees is 3.49 N*m; this is not an actuator rating.

records.name: Strain-wave reducer
records.problem_solved: High coaxial ratio through a deformable toothed cup
records.physics_representation: Equivalent ratio -100/(102-100)=-50 with compliance; FEM for cup stress
records.missing_for_validated_simulation: Conjugate profiles, wave generator geometry, wall strain, fatigue and losses
records.fabrication_route: Printed proof of geometry or precision manufactured assembly
records.notes: Proposed tooth counts yield 50:1 for fixed circular spline; profile generator is not a manufacturing-ready actuator.
